title: India wants critical sectors on indigenous AI models
takeaways_title: The sovereign AI push in 5 numbers
takeaways: 20 AI models approved under IndiaAI, built by 12 startups.
EKA-1: 26.3 billion parameters, 22 Indian languages plus English.
Some domestic models reach up to 80% of frontier capacity.
AI funding hit $1.6 billion; infrastructure took 75%.
Model builders got 83% of compute subsidy; researchers 0.8%.
source_note: Sources: MediaNama, News On AIR, Tracxn via Elets CIO, ThePrint
